svg.title: D for Display and Standee Design
svg.desc: A 6.5-second looping animation. A pencil reveals the original D illustration; the letter becomes a display and standee design story, with examples of a display board, a roll-up standee, and an event space. The original illustration is traced as editable vector paths.
svg.metadata: 16:9; 1920 by 1080; 6.5-second loop; based on 04_D_designing.png; no external assets.

g.text: DESIGNED TO BE SEEN. BUILT TO STAND OUT.
